reviews.t: Great set for a great price!
reviews.x: I bought and received these today (thank you Amazon Prime!) along with the MelodySusie LED light. I wanted to start out with the Gelish base+topcoat, as that is what all the bloggers I follow use+recommend- but this was my first time using gel polish, so I wanted it as cheap and as fast as possible! This also came with an array of colors that I actually liked, which is shocking! I liked that they were a smaller size, in case I hated using the gels. Now I wish they were bigger, because I love the
Kind of disappointed chipped in the first day... besides that colors are cute....followed directions also bought a $40 uv lamp did a base coat two coats of polish then top coat...

This set is a great range of neutral colors. The colors that you see on screen are very true to the colors in real life. I purchased this set to use to have neutral nails during my maternity photo shoot, and I had several options to choose from. I have done my own gel nails for quite a while, and I have tried many different brands. This brand is high quality. The color glides on easily and doesn't clump or become too thick. I only need to apply two coats to get desired color and coverage and the

These polishes work wonders. I am able to get at least 2 weeks of wear out of 2 coats. I found it very helpful to take a little bit of the color on a tooth pick and make a mark on the the polish lid, then cure it. This way you can easily see what color you are grabbing. The bottles are a descent size, easy storage. The colors all compliment each other as well which is nice for an accent nail. I am very happy with these colors and i will be purchasing more from this company!

Great polishes. Good quality. Nice subtle colors.  Note that bottles are 8ml. Polish lasts for 2 weeks or more without chipping or peeling. Had them on my toes for 4 weeks and no chips or peels. Ive included pics. The more purple polish on my fingers is messier bc I was getting the hang of the polish. First timer. The beige color is my second time around. I also painted the color on each bottle so I know what's inside without opening them.

reviews.t: Wow! Easy to apply and long-lasting.
reviews.x: I got this as part of a "starter kit" since I just recently learned about gel polish. I'm terrible with regular nail polish, so I was expecting this to be a huge mess.  Not so!  The instructions are easy to follow and the polish is thick enough to stay in place while not being lumpy or tough to apply. My polish looked perfect once I was finished and lasted for over two weeks without a nick or scratch. (I work with my hands a LOT and can usually destroy a manicure within two days.)  I've

I really love this gel polish! It's stays on very well!! I'd say between 2 and 3 weeks. The base and top coat also work well with other products (I've used Essie, opi and gelish) without any problems! The colors are very true to the description. The amount in the bottles is good for the price especially if you're one of those people that doesn't use it fast enough, my big bottles always go bad before I use them. It's great because you get so many colors for such a low price! 10/10 recommend! Sup

They don't fill their bottles and the description is inaccurate.  Product does not cure under LED light.  I have used Sensational and Gelish for a long time and never had an issue.  Now I know why the price is so low.  Spend the extra money and go with Sensational or Gelish.  You will not be happy with the results from this polish.  Mine was peeling off after 4 hours and never fully cured under the LED light.

Gel nail polish is great! Perfect consistency that makes it easy to work with. The bottle are small, but for 6 colors and a top and bottom coat this package is a steal! Will definitely be buying more.

reviews.t: This is my second time using this set just not happy with them
reviews.x: This polish is very thick.  This is my second time using this set just not happy with them.  Colors are true to color on internet.
I like the product, however the base coat bubbles at times. I used a different brand and no bubbles. The colors are very nice!

reviews.t: The bottles of polish are beyond small. You might ...
reviews.x: The bottles of polish are beyond small. You might be able to use each bottle two times. Not worth the money
Horrible product.  Polish actually slid off my nails instead of drying!  Micro size bottles.
Would be nice if they put the color on the lid instead of just a code.

I actually didn't expect much from this set. And the bottles are small but surprisingly long-lasting. I have used all but one color and had good success. The only color I don't love is the red. It is thin and even with three coats didn't seem to look right. But the others are perfectly fine. This is a good start if you are new to gel polish. Although the brush shape isn't for beginners. It's a little squared off and makes getting in the curve of the nail tricky. But my polish is lasting about te

reviews.t: The polish went on great with great coverage even for the light colors
reviews.x: I had purchased some other brand at a local beauty store and it chipped the next day.  Candy Lover Gel polish has been on for over 8 days with not a single chip.  It is holding up just the polish from the salon.  The polish went on great with great coverage even for the light colors.  I will defiantly purchase again and recommend to others.  Be sure to follow the instructions and be sure to wipe with cotton ball/paper towel dipped in rubbing alcohol.

I really wanted to like the product because of its price and color selection but the performance of Candy Lover is horrible. I am a fun of Shellac but it became very difficult to get on Amazon. I decided to give a chance to Candy Lover and the next morning after doing my nails, the polish started chipping. I did my nails on Sunday and used my LED lamp. Today is Tuesday and my nails need another manicure. I can't believe I wasted 21$!

I finally tried these out, and these are great! They are just like what's used in the salon but it's so much cheaper to do it yourself. Make sure you have a UV or LED nail lamp to dry and you're good to go. I have a UV lamp and I find that I have to cure for a little longer than 2 minutes (but I could be painting it on a little thick; still getting used to gel), but it's worth it since my nails last a good two weeks.

reviews.t: ... were but by expectations were greatly surpassed by the great quality. Followed the directons and prepped my nails ..
reviews.x: I received these polishes on time not expecting much because of how inexpensive they were but by expectations were greatly surpassed by the great quality. Followed the directons and prepped my nails accordingly and the polish went on without any problem. It turned out smooth and shiny without any hassle. The color options were gorgeous and I will definitely want to try more colors from them.

I read all the reviews and many people said how these nail polishes lasted 3 weeks. I was so excited to try them out. This nail polish just doesn't apply smooth, after about 4 days started chipping and it just never feels like it's fully dry, it's cheap but I bought cheaper polish in bigger bottles that applies much better and lasted longer without chipping. Glad I only bought one set

These polishes are gorgeous and look wonderful.  I am new to DIY Gel and these made it easy and simple.  The bottles are smaller than your standard nail polish but they seem to last longer too.  The red is my favorite color and when you do 3 coats it becomes a dark deep burgundy, perfect for this time of year!  I can't wait to order more!

reviews.t: Cool pack with top and base coat
reviews.x: Its cool that the set comes with top and base coat but all the bottles are extremely tiny and i dont know if its cuz i am inexperienced,  but the polished seemed very thick and as if it had particles in it. But, still cool pack for the price and my nails turned out fine.

The colors are true the picture, but after using a few of these guys it would not dry to the uv light when exposed, which resulted in bubbling under the layers of shellac applied. This has never happened to me with my other shellac brand polishes. Disappointed.

reviews.t: Beautiful colors and very long lasting
reviews.x: I am in love with all the colors! I am so happy I made this purchase because I am saving a lot of money going to the nail salon. I will definitely be buying more colors from this vendor. Check out my pictures after 10 days of use my nails still look good :)

Awesome product! If you cure with a light between each coat for 30 seconds the results will last for weeks. From my experience it is almost impossible to chip these polishes. I also get compliments every time I have these colors on my nails!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the polish long-lasting, often getting two weeks or more of wear without chipping.
Reviewers frequently praise the colors as true to the online images and nice neutral shades.
Several reviewers complain that the bottles are very small, with some saying they are not worth the money.
Some reviewers report application or curing problems, including chipping, sliding off, or not curing under LED light.
Multiple reviewers describe the polish as easy to apply with a good consistency.
